scripts.build:ui: cd "Steam Desktop Authenticator" && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i ui/tailwind-input.css -o ui/assets/css/app.css --minify
scripts.check:ui: npm run build:ui && git diff --exit-code -- "Steam Desktop Authenticator/ui/assets/css/app.css"
scripts.prepare: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const check = spawnSync('git', ['rev-parse', '--is-inside-work-tree'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); if (check.status === 0) { const configure = spawnSync('git', ['config', '--local', 'core.hooksPath', '.githooks'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(configure.status ?? 1); }"
